description: Datos Abiertos Emergencias Atendidas Por Bomberos De Bucaramanga is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bucaramanga, Santander. Registro de datos respecto a emergencias atendidas por el cuerpo de bomberos del municipio de Bucaramanga. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bucaramanga, Santander. Its tags are bomberos, cuerpo de bomberos, atención de emergencias, emergencias, cuerpo oficial de bomberos de bucaramanga. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Organismos de Control. The portal shows 2023-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
